---
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date())`"
params:
  res_path: "seny_result.rds"
  max_cards: 100
  title: "seny report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    self_contained: true
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# render with seny::reportSeny(res), or edit a copy from
# rmarkdown::draft("my_report.Rmd", template = "seny_report", package = "seny")
# and point params$res_path at a saved assessAll() result
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, dpi = 80,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4)
if (!"package:seny" %in% search()) library(seny)
res <- readRDS(params$res_path)
d <- as.data.frame(res)
settings <- attr(res, "settings")
d$contrast <- paste0(d$B, " vs ", d$A)
call_levels <- c("Invalid", "Caution", "Underpowered", "Adequate")
call_colours <- c(Adequate = "#1A9850", Underpowered = "#FEE08B", Caution = "#FDAE61",
                  Invalid = "#D73027")
anchor <- function(key) paste0("card-", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", key))

# comparisons that get a card: flagged first (Invalid, Caution, Underpowered), then
# Adequate; by expected recall within each call; capped at max_cards
ord <- order(match(as.character(d$call), call_levels), d$expected_recall, na.last = TRUE)
card_keys <- head(d$comparison[ord], params$max_cards)
n_left_out <- nrow(d) - length(card_keys)
```

## Summary

```{r summary-numbers, results = "asis"}
n_cmp <- nrow(d)
calls <- table(factor(as.character(d$call), levels = rev(call_levels)))
cat(sprintf("**%d comparisons** were assessed across %d annotation level(s) (%s) and %d contrast(s).\n\n",
            n_cmp, length(unique(d$annotation)), paste(unique(d$annotation), collapse = ", "),
            length(unique(d$contrast))))
cat(paste0("- **", names(calls), "**: ", as.integer(calls), " (", round(100 * as.integer(calls) / n_cmp), "%)",
           collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
if (!is.null(settings) && isTRUE(settings$thetaReps == 0)) {
    cat(paste0("*The depth / cell / donor variance attribution was not computed (`thetaReps = 0`, the fast ",
               "default; the calls do not use it). Rerun `assessAll(..., thetaReps = 3)` to see whether more ",
               "donors or more cells would help each comparison.*\n\n"))
}
cat(sprintf(paste0(
    '<div style="border-left: 4px solid #FDAE61; padding: 0.5em 1em; background: #FFF8EE;">',
    "<b>%d comparisons were assessed.</b> Report the full table, not only the comparisons that ",
    "look interesting: selecting standouts after the fact inflates false positives.</div>\n\n"), n_cmp))
```

```{r summary-reasons}
flagged <- d$flags[as.character(d$call) != "Adequate"]
codes <- unlist(strsplit(flagged[nzchar(flagged)], ";"))
if (length(codes)) {
    labels <- c(underpowered = "underpowered at the target effect", few_testable = "too few testable genes",
                composition = "subtype composition shift", imbalance = "cell-count imbalance",
                confounded = "confounded with a covariate", too_few_samples = "too few samples per group",
                not_estimable = "design not estimable")
    tab <- sort(table(codes), decreasing = TRUE)
    knitr::kable(data.frame(reason = unname(ifelse(names(tab) %in% names(labels), labels[names(tab)], names(tab))),
                            comparisons = as.integer(tab)),
                 caption = "Reasons behind the non-Adequate calls (a comparison can have several)")
}
```

```{r settings}
if (!is.null(settings)) {
    st <- data.frame(setting = c("seny version", "DE method", "target |log2FC|", "power", "FDR",
                                 "sample", "group", "covariates", "minCells", "theta reps"),
                     value = c(settings$version, settings$method, settings$targetLFC, settings$power,
                               settings$fdr, settings$sample, settings$group,
                               if (length(settings$covariates)) paste(settings$covariates, collapse = ", ") else "none",
                               settings$minCells, settings$thetaReps))
    knitr::kable(st, caption = "Settings of this run")
}
```

## Traffic-light matrices

```{r matrix-size, include = FALSE}
n_rows <- max(table(d$annotation[!duplicated(paste(d$annotation, d$cluster))]))
h_matrix <- min(30, 1.5 + 0.25 * n_rows)
```

```{r matrices, fig.height = h_matrix}
for (cur in plotAdequacy(res)) print(cur)
```

## Comparison table

Every comparison, sortable and searchable. Rows with a card link to it.

```{r table}
cols <- intersect(c("annotation", "cluster", "contrast", "call", "expected_recall", "nA", "nB",
                    "median_cells", "composition", "flags", "reason"), colnames(d))
tab <- d[, cols]
tab$expected_recall <- round(tab$expected_recall, 2)
tab$card <- ifelse(d$comparison %in% card_keys,
                   paste0('<a href="#', anchor(d$comparison), '">card</a>'), "")
DT::formatStyle(
    DT::datatable(tab, escape = setdiff(seq_along(tab), ncol(tab)), rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                  extensions = "Buttons",
                  options = list(dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = list("csv"), pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE)),
    "call", backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(names(call_colours), unname(call_colours)))
```

## Design and variance

```{r design-plots, fig.height = 5}
n_clusters <- length(unique(paste(d$annotation, d$cluster)))
if (n_clusters <= 40) {
    print(plotCells(res))
} else {
    cat("Cells per sample: not drawn for", n_clusters, "clusters; see the comparison cards.\n")
}
if (!is.null(settings) && length(settings$covariates)) print(plotConfounding(res))
if (!is.null(settings) && isTRUE(settings$thetaReps > 0)) {
    print(plotVariance(res))
    print(plotRegime(res))
}
```

## Composition

```{r composition, results = "asis", fig.height = 4.5, fig.width = 10}
comp_keys <- d$comparison[grepl("composition", d$flags)]
if (all(d$composition %in% c("not assessed", NA))) {
    cat("Composition was not assessed: it needs two nested annotation levels (e.g. broad and fine).\n")
} else if (length(comp_keys) == 0) {
    cat("No comparison has a composition Caution.\n")
} else {
    cat(length(comp_keys), "comparison(s) have a composition Caution: a subtype shift within the cluster",
        "is expected to make genes look differentially expressed on its own.\n\n")
    for (cur in head(comp_keys, params$max_cards)) {
        cat("\n\n###", cur, "\n\n")
        print(plotComposition(res, cur))
    }
}
```

## Comparison cards

```{r cards, results = "asis", fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10}
cat(sprintf("%d card(s), flagged comparisons first.", length(card_keys)))
if (n_left_out > 0) {
    cat(sprintf(" %d comparison(s) left out (`maxCards = %d`); every comparison is in the table above.",
                n_left_out, params$max_cards))
}
cat("\n\n")
for (cur in card_keys) {
    row <- d[d$comparison == cur, ]
    cat(sprintf('\n\n### %s : %s {#%s}\n\n**%s** --- %s\n\n', row$cluster, row$contrast, anchor(cur),
                as.character(row$call), row$reason))
    print(plotComparison(res, cur))
}
```

## Appendix

```{r thresholds}
if (!is.null(settings)) {
    th <- settings$thresholds
    def <- defaultThresholds()
    src <- seny:::threshold_sources()
    knitr::kable(data.frame(threshold = names(th), value = vapply(th, format, character(1)),
                            default = vapply(def[names(th)], format, character(1)),
                            source = unname(src[names(th)])),
                 caption = "Thresholds used and where each comes from")
}
```
